{{Quote|One of our neutral contacts has been kidnapped by the Death Watch operatives on Endor. We need someone to rescue him. Naturally, we can only trust a fellow member of the Alliance. You came at the perfect time and would be an excellent candidiate to help us in our cause. Will you help us?|Lutin Nightstalker|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Lutin Nightstalker''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[General/Legends|general]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who operated out of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Nightstalker tasked a Rebel operative with forming a group and launching a mission to the [[Death Watch bunker]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lutin Nightstalker was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
